item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2023 evidence of Putin consistently responding to domestic crises with broad restraint, civilian protection, or de-escalation. The only real counterevidence is the Wagner decision to avoid immediate bloodshed and limited rescue efforts after Kakhovka; both are narrow and do not offset the wider repression pattern.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia's Putin says he let mutiny continue to avoid bloodshed","publisher":"Reuters","date":"26 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-putin-says-he-let-mutiny-continue-to-avoid-bloodshed-3113594","summary":"Putin said he deliberately let the Wagner mutiny run its course to avoid bloodshed and thanked fighters who stood down. This is the strongest restraint-adjacent evidence for a spontaneous domestic flare-up, but it is narrow crisis containment, not a broader nonviolent governing pattern.","question_ids":["3B.9","2B.5"]},{"title":"Russia's Putin says he let mutiny continue to avoid bloodshed","publisher":"Reuters","date":"26 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-putin-says-he-let-mutiny-continue-to-avoid-bloodshed-3113594","summary":"In the same statement Putin framed the mutiny as treason and said the organizers had betrayed their country and people. That undercuts the restraint reading because he paired de-escalation with vilification and punishment rhetoric.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.3","2B.5"]},{"title":"Moment: Putin says Wagner mutiny is ‘treason’ in televised address","publisher":"Reuters Connect","date":"24 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/moment-putin-says-wagner-mutiny-is-treason-in-televised-address/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMucom,2023:newsml_VA240124062023RP1","summary":"Putin publicly called the Wagner rebellion treason and promised punishment. This is evidence of a coercive, punitive response to a domestic security crisis rather than a purely protective one.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Putin accuses Ukraine of destroying the Kakhovka dam at behest of West","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"7 Jun 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-accuses-ukraine-of-destroying-the-kakhovka-dam-at-behest-of-west/1617195/","summary":"Putin ordered rescue efforts after the dam breach, which is the best limited operational protection evidence I found. But he simultaneously blamed Ukraine and Western sponsors, so the response was rescue plus blame-shifting rather than a broader restraint model.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.7","2B.9"]},{"title":"Russia crosses new lines in crackdown on Putin's enemies","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"21 Apr 2023","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/analysisrussia-crosses-new-lines-in-crackdown-on-putins-enemies-2992615","summary":"Reuters described security services and courts as crossing new thresholds in a campaign against perceived enemies, spies, and traitors. That supports the reading that crises were being met with intimidation and selective punishment, not just protection.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.1"]},{"title":"Putin rewards soldiers after Wagner mutiny","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"27 Jun 2023","url":"https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/71520","summary":"After the mutiny, Putin publicly rewarded soldiers and cast the military as the guarantor of state stability. This looks more like militarized spectacle and loyalty management than a crisis response centered on civilian protection.","question_ids":["3B.9","2B.8","2B.5"]},{"title":"2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Russia","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"22 Apr 2024","url":"https://www.state.gov/reports/2023-country-reports-on-human-rights-practices/russia","summary":"The report says authorities jailed antiwar protesters, restricted media, forced NGO closures, and opened 844 criminal cases for antiwar expression. That is the broader background pattern: domestic crises were met with fear, censorship, and punishment rather than sustained protection.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.6","3B.5"]}]}
